requested: Policies, directives, checklists, templates, frequency, scope, sampling, documentation, assignment to Hicks, dates and revisions; checks for purpose, cases, access, retention, sharing and prohibited use.
supplied and locator: 40915671.pdf, pp. 1–5: effective March 24, 2026; Chief or designee audits at least annually; scope and three-year findings retention on p. 4; supervisory reviews on p. 4.
assessment and limits: Partial policy response. No monthly-audit directive, named assignment to Hicks, sampling method, checklist, adoption record or revision history identified. Annual minimum does not exclude monthly reviews.

requested: Each completed review, reports, checklists, workpapers, logs, sign-offs, findings, corrections, reviewer/date/period/sample/exception disposition; distinct from raw activity logs.
supplied and locator: FOIA Flock Audit Statement.pdf, p. 1: Edwards says no releasable discipline records for misuse as of October 14, citing an employee-performance-record provision. Policy p. 4 describes audit requirements.
assessment and limits: No completed audit or review identified. A discipline-disclosure statement is not audit workpapers and does not say no audits, no misuse or no discipline ever occurred. The supplied statement does not resolve the whole category.

requested: Settings for images, searches, outcomes, statistics and logs; automatic deletion/change records; investigation/legal-hold exceptions; exports, inventories and off-platform retention.
supplied and locator: Policy p. 3: captured plate data no longer than 150 days unless associated with investigation/prosecution. Audit findings: at least three years (p. 4); statistical reports: eighteen months (p. 5).
assessment and limits: Policy limits are not actual configured retention. No 30-day configuration, automatic-deletion schedule, preservation/export log or archive-copy rule identified. A 150-day ceiling can coexist with a 30-day setting; this production does not establish that setting.

requested: Agreements, descriptions, inventories, diagrams or correspondence distinguishing vendor-hosted and City-maintained storage; hosting, control, processing and subcontractors, excluding security secrets.
supplied and locator: Policy p. 3 says secure servers approved by the department. Flock sole source letter.pdf, p. 1 lists an integrated cloud platform and cloud storage of footage.
assessment and limits: Generic policy and vendor product description only. Neither identifies Sherwood’s actual configuration, physical storage, custodian, administrators, subcontractors or any City archive. Vendor cloud language alone does not disprove an in-house copy.

requested: User/badge identification, case numbers, reasons; whether required at login, search or outcome; handling incomplete entries; no authentication secrets.
supplied and locator: Policy p. 2 requires individual login credentials. Policy p. 3 instructs officers to mark alert outcomes, completing applicable fields including CFS number, category, arrests, disposition, activity, other crimes and vehicle recovery. Policy p. 4 lists query justification in audit scope.
assessment and limits: Partial. Alert-outcome entry differs from login or search enforcement. No badge-number requirement, actual search form/configuration, mandatory case/reason validation or missing-entry handling identified.

requested: Review/revisions responding to August 13 recordkeeping deficiencies; recommendations, approvals, implementation, training, vendor correspondence, completion evaluation and completed six-month statistical reports.
supplied and locator: Policy effective March 24, 2026 requires six-month reports listing scans, databases, hits, confirmed hits, false alerts, resulting arrests/prosecutions and initiated investigations (p. 5).
assessment and limits: No corrective-action record or completed six-month report identified. A March policy predates the August response and does not demonstrate a later correction. This finding is limited to this six-file production.

requested: Existing reports, spreadsheets, dashboards, calculations, summaries or memoranda; reporting period, numerator, denominator, definitions of case/solved and attribution method. No new calculation requested.
supplied and locator: CITY 2026-193.pdf, p. 1: Captain Scott Hicks, October 20, 2026, 3:32 PM, says the department has no supporting documentation to substantiate the statement. Pages 2–4 repeat the submitted request.
assessment and limits: Explicit lack-of-support statement. No period, counts, definitions or attribution method supplied. The production fails to substantiate 40%; it does not calculate the true percentage, disprove 40%, establish intent or show what source the Mayor personally relied on.

requested: Communications transmitting, approving, revising or discussing requested practices among Police, Mayor’s Office, FOIA staff, IT and Flock, with complete chains and responsive attachments.
supplied and locator: CITY 2026-193.pdf contains Hicks’s reply, James’s October 14 forwarding message and the JustFOIA request notification. The discipline statement is also an email. BRINC DFR FOIA Request.pdf expressly references CITY-2026-199.
assessment and limits: Some responsive correspondence. No substantive Mayor/IT/Flock discussion of these requested Flock practices identified. Drone procurement correspondence is included as received, without treating it as an answer to Flock audit or case-solving questions.
